title: Ada and the Tide
author: Petra Ishikawa
blurb: Kestrel Underhill, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
